rule: Section 11: each model's stated training cutoff from its provider's documentation. A unit is leak-exposed for a model when its earliest exposure falls on or before the cutoff; a month-stated cutoff covers that whole month. A model with no published cutoff runs with that limit stated beside its results. More than a quarter of a model's units leak-exposed makes its primaries untested (leak).

opus.note: The repository's earlier records note data possibly collected to September 2026 (unverified), which covers the whole merge window; the strict stratum, the by-month print and the recognition probe answer it.

particle.note: Particle's model catalog, read 2026-11-08, states no knowledge or training cutoff for particle-1. Section 11 asks for its release date where no cutoff is published; this build did not read one, so the run thread records it here before stage 1. A release date is a stated limit, not a cutoff, so the leak rule does not apply it; particle-1 runs with that limit stated beside its results.
